QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.HISTOIRE_TEXTE: Founded in March 2012, Chance De Vivre-Togo is a non-profit association based in the Zio prefecture, in Togo's Maritime Region. Its mission: to support the most disadvantaged towards access to education and healthcare, with particular attention to young people and their training. It works in the health and social field — caring for the sick, orphans and vulnerable children, people living with HIV/AIDS and widows — and was profoundly transformed by meeting its key partner, Tukolere Wamu.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_SOLIDARITE_TEXTE: Acting alongside communities, with them and for them.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_TRANSPARENCE_TEXTE: Being accountable to our partners and the public for our actions.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_IMPACT_TEXTE: Favouring actions that durably improve everyday life.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.ZONE_TEXTE: Our work spans four of Togo's five regions: the Maritime Region (Assomé, Davié, Tsévié), the Plateaux Region (Kpalimé, Agodeke, Yokélé, Avetonou, Danyi N'Digbé, Agbonou, Anié), the Kara Region (Bafilo, N'Kassaïdé) and the Savanes Region (Batambouré, Dapaong).

MISSIONS.SOUS_TITRE: Four pillars, one ambition: durably improving the lives of Togolese communities.
